svg.text: D08 · F3 PREPARE THE RIVAL (A1 SUCCESS)

text.tspan: User control over the AI result: regenerate, start, or practise
Ask for another strategy: regenerate the AI result.
Start repeats difficulty and plan and says it counts toward
the voyage. Enter is the shortcut.
Short practice: same rival and strategy, nothing saved.
"How does the AI rival work?" says what the model decides
and what the game always owns (collisions, scoring,
Explains Escape, F3 and F before the full-screen stage
